---
title: "gg_box"
---
<br>
```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  collapse = TRUE,
  comment = "> "
)
```

```{r setup}
library(saferGG)
```
<br>

### Datasets

```{r}
set.seed(1) ; obs1 <- data.frame(Time = c(rnorm(20, 100, 10), rnorm(20, 200, 50), rnorm(20, 500, 60), rnorm(20, 100, 50)), Categ1 = rep(c("CAT", "DOG"), times = 40), Categ2 = rep(c("A", "B", "C", "D"), each = 20), Color1 = rep(c("coral", "lightblue"), times = 40), Color2 = rep(c("#9F2108", "#306100", "#007479", "#8500C0"), each = 20), stringsAsFactors = TRUE) ; set.seed(NULL) # random dataset of 80 values distributed in 2 categories of 2 classes each
```
<br>

### Dataset info

```{r}
utils::head(obs1) # head of the dataset
```
<br>

### Simple example

```{r}
gg_box(data1 = obs1, y = "Time", categ = "Categ1")
```
<br>

### Argument categ_class_order

```{r}
gg_box(data1 = obs1, y = "Time", categ = "Categ1", categ_class_order = list(c("DOG", "CAT")))
```
<br>

### Argument categ_color

```{r}
gg_box(data1 = obs1, y = "Time", categ = "Categ1", categ_color = c("coral", "lightblue"))
```
<br>

### Arguments box_legend_name, box_fill, box_notch and box_mean

```{r}
gg_box(data1 = obs1, y = "Time", categ = "Categ1", box_legend_name = "ANIMAL", box_fill = TRUE, box_notch = TRUE, box_mean = FALSE)
```
<br>

### Arguments dot_categ, dot_categ_class_order and dot_color

```{r}
gg_box(data1 = obs1, y = "Time", categ = "Categ1", dot_categ = "Categ2", dot_categ_class_order = c("D", "C", "B", "A"), dot_color = c("#9F2108", "#306100", "#007479", "#8500C0"))
```
<br>

### Arguments x_lab, y_lab, x_angle and title

```{r}
gg_box(data1 = obs1, y = "Time", categ = "Categ1", x_lab = "CATEGORY", y_lab = "TIME", x_angle = 45, title = "GRAPH 1")
```
<br>

### Arguments y_lim, y_log, y_tick_nb, y_include_zero and y_top_extra_margin

```{r}
gg_box(data1 = obs1, y = "Time", categ = "Categ1", y_lim = c(0, 600), y_log = "no", y_tick_nb = 4, y_include_zero = TRUE, y_top_extra_margin = 0.1)
```
<br>

### Log scale example

```{r}
gg_box(data1 = obs1, y = "Time", categ = "Categ1", y_lim = c(1, 600), y_log = "log10", y_tick_nb = 4)
```
<br>

### Arguments stat_mean, stat_size, stat_dist, stat_angle and vertical

```{r}
gg_box(data1 = obs1, y = "Time", categ = "Categ1", stat_mean = TRUE, stat_size = 4, stat_dist = 0.3, stat_angle = 90, vertical = TRUE)
```
<br>

### Arguments return, return_ggplot, return_gtable, plot and add

```{r}
gg_box(data1 = obs1, y = "Time", categ = "Categ1", return = TRUE, plot = FALSE)
gg_box(data1 = obs1, y = "Time", categ = "Categ1", return_ggplot = TRUE, add = "+ggplot2::coord_flip()", plot = FALSE)
```
<br>
